name: gluth
_comment: FULLY LEVEL-2 Gluth (A3). TANK PLAN: the MAIN tank and ONE dedicated swap tank (offtank1 = first assist tank) ping-pong Gluth on Mortal Wound via tank_swap watch:victim, stacks:3 -- each holds + goes ham while it's the active tank and TAUNTS when the other hits 3 stacks; the off one stands ready and does NOT attack Gluth (no pull-aggro). EXTRA tanks (offtank2, offtank3) tank the Zombie Chow at the back (spawn area 3280,-3160): they actively melee the nearest chow (attack) AND AoE-threat the pile (snare_area), and kite the ring if >=6 swarm them. KITERS (mages+hunters) orbit the spawn area and snare the chow (esp. the ones leaking toward Gluth), bringing the pile to the chow-OTs; their pets are disabled (pet attack suppressed) so they don't scatter the chow. Everyone else burns Gluth + bursts the decimated chow during the Decimate window (attack max_hp_pct). Coords + spell lists + the stacks threshold are RELOAD-tunable. NOTE: if you only field one OT it becomes the swap tank and chow lean on the kiters + raid AoE -- add a 2nd/3rd tank for real chow tanking. A/B with .rjson off.

rules._comment: MAIN TANK: ping-pong Gluth with the swap tank. tank_swap@5 (watch:victim) -- while I'm the active tank it holds Gluth and yields to my rotation (go ham); when the OTHER tank (the swap-OT) is the victim and hits 3 Mortal Wound stacks I taunt Gluth back; while waiting (the MT yields) my own rules tank normally. stack_point@2 keeps Gluth pinned at the NE anchor (walks there, then yields so the rotation/attack fire); attack@1 engages Gluth on the pull and re-acquires after a taunt. detect:nearest so the gate works the moment I've been taunted off.

SWAP TANK (offtank1 = first assist tank): its ENTIRE job is the Mortal Wound swap. tank_swap@5 (watch:victim) -- stands ready and does NOT attack Gluth while the MT tanks; when the MT hits 3 stacks it taunts + goes ham (holds Gluth, rotation pounds it) until ITS stacks hit 3 and the MT taunts back. No other rule, so when it's the active tank the tick falls through to its full combat rotation (max threat/DPS), and when waiting tank_swap owns the tick so it never drifts onto Gluth early.

KITERS (mages + hunters): orbit the chow spawn area (3280,-3160, r15) and snare the nearest chow within 35y -- slowing/rooting their march on Gluth and pulling them toward the chow-OTs at center. class:"mage,hunter" + detect:nearest (they never threaten Gluth). snare_area@7 fires the first known + off-CD snare, then yields to orbit_point@6. Pets are disabled below so they don't scatter the chow / pull Gluth. Full-time -- no Gluth DPS from them.

RANGED DPS + HEALERS cluster SW of the tank (away from the north door); ranged then fall through to attack Gluth, healers heal. (Kiters match role 'ranged' but don't threaten Gluth, so this threat-detect rule never fires for them.)
ALL DPS tunnel Gluth (melee close via the un-suppressed 'reach melee').
DECIMATE-BURN PIVOT, melee reach (max_hp_pct:10 self-gates to the burn; boss:"" = no fallback so they stay on Gluth otherwise; max_range:10 keeps melee from chasing).
DECIMATE-BURN PIVOT, ranged reach (max_range:35). Non-kiter ranged catch decimated chow crossing the room.

CHOW TANKS (offtank2, offtank3 = 2nd/3rd assist tanks): actively tank the chow at the back. snare_area@3 AoE-threats the nearest chow within 12y (this is what pulls chow off their march to Gluth); attack@2 keeps the OT meleeing the nearest chow (sustained threat + auto-attack -- the fix for the chow tank standing around doing nothing); stack_point hold:true @1 parks them at the spawn area and owns the tick when there are no chow yet so they don't run at Gluth. detect:nearest (they never threaten Gluth). boss:"" on attack so it never falls back to hitting Gluth.
CHOW TANK KITES when swarmed: if >=6 chow pile within 9y of a chow tank, orbit the spawn ring (3280,-3160, r18) so it isn't bursted down. orbit_point@4 beats the snare/attack/hold while active.

suppress._comment: Everyone engaged: no formation-follow / master-follow during the fight.
ALL OFF-TANKS (swap + chow, threat-independent): zero dps/tank assist, flee, formation, follow so they don't charge Gluth or get dragged off their job. tank_swap force-runs the swap taunt regardless.
KITERS (mages/hunters): same suppression, PLUS 'pet attack' so hunter pets don't run off to maul / scatter the chow or peel one toward Gluth.

MAIN TANK: zero its own auto 'taunt spell' so it doesn't yank Gluth back off the swap tank mid-window. Its scheduled taunt-back still fires -- tank_swap force-runs that via DoSpecificAction, which bypasses suppress.
